notes: No model in the repository reads from this source; variables are the full lexicon VOCAB. (earth2studio/lexicon/ibtracs.py IBTrACSLexicon.VOCAB, 9 keys).

recipes/tc_tracking uses IBTrACS data but downloads the NCEI CSV itself (recipes/tc_tracking/src/modes/baseline_extraction.py:42-66); it does not use earth2studio.data.IBTrACS, so it is not counted as a pairing.

region and 1 day tolerance follow the class docstring example (ibtracs.py:142); the constructor default region is 'ALL', which downloads a much larger file. Time is during Hurricane Helene (NA) and Hurricane John (EP).
Cost is the basin file download and is independent of the variable count.
